'''Haven's Blaze''' was a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] and a rival of the [[Lucky Runner]] casino. The rivalry was notable to the extent that its owner [[Otheros]] put a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Lucky Runner [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncers]].
